title: Майбутнє: will, going to, Present Continuous
titleEn: Future forms: will vs going to vs Present Continuous
explanation:
- **will** + V: *I'll call · It won't rain · Will you help?* (*'ll*, *won't*)
- **be going to** + V: *I'm going to buy · She isn't going to come · Are you going to stay?*
- **Present Continuous** (am / is / are + V-ing) + час: *We're meeting at six.*
- **Present Simple** — розклад: *The film starts at 8.*
- **Shall I / we** + V? — пропозиція: *Shall I open the window?*

Після *when, if, as soon as, before, after, until* — **Present Simple** навіть про майбутнє: *I'll call you when I **get** home.*

guide.idea: В англійській немає одного «майбутнього часу» — форму обирають за тим, звідки береться майбутнє: вирішили щойно (will), задумали заздалегідь (going to), уже домовились (Present Continuous) чи це розклад (Present Simple).

use.en: It's cold in here. I'll close the window.

use.note: I'll…, I won't…, Will you…? — та сама will.
use.en: Don't worry, I won't tell anyone.
use.uk: Не хвилюйся, я нікому не скажу.

use.note: Намір уже є, хоча деталі ще не домовлено, — be going to.
use.en: We're going to redecorate the living room this summer.
use.uk: Цього літа ми збираємося зробити ремонт у вітальні.

use.note: Уже в календарі, інша людина теж знає — Present Continuous.
use.en: I'm having lunch with Sophie on Friday.
use.uk: У п'ятницю я обідаю з Софі.

use.note: Думка — will (I think, probably); доказ видно просто зараз — going to.
use.en: Look at that sky — it's going to pour.

use.note: Потяги, фільми, уроки за розкладом — Present Simple.
use.en: Our flight leaves at 6.40 tomorrow morning.
use.uk: Наш рейс вилітає завтра о 6:40 ранку.

a.en: — We've run out of milk. — Oh, I'll buy some.
a.uk: — У нас закінчилося молоко. — О, я куплю.

b.en: I'm going to buy some milk — do you need anything?
b.uk: Я йду купити молока — тобі щось треба?
b.note: Рішення ухвалено раніше, зараз лише виконую.

a.en: I'm going to see a dentist.

b.en: I'm seeing the dentist at three tomorrow.
b.uk: Завтра о третій я йду до стоматолога.

a.en: I think Emma will love the present.

b.en: Careful — that glass is going to fall!

mistakes.wrong: I will call you when I will get home.
mistakes.right: I'll call you when I get home.
mistakes.why: Після when, if, as soon as — Present Simple навіть про майбутнє.

mistakes.wrong: — The phone's ringing. — I'm going to answer it.
mistakes.right: — The phone's ringing. — I'll get it.

mistakes.wrong: I go to the cinema tomorrow.
mistakes.right: I'm going to the cinema tomorrow.
mistakes.why: Present Simple про майбутнє — лише розклади; особисті плани — Present Continuous або going to.

formula: will + V · be going to + V · am/is/are + V-ing

examples.en: The phone's ringing. — I'll get it!
We're going to paint the bedroom this weekend.
examples.uk: Цих вихідних ми збираємося пофарбувати спальню.

examples.en: I'm seeing the doctor on Thursday.
examples.uk: У четвер у мене прийом у лікаря.

examples.en: I promise I won't tell anyone.
Watch out! You're going to fall!
I'll text you as soon as I arrive.

tip: *Shall I…?* — пропозиція: *Shall I open the window?* (Відкрити вікно?)

exercises.prompt: I'm thirsty. — I ___ get you some water.
We ___ buy a new car next year. We've already saved the money.
I ___ my parents on Sunday — we've booked the tickets.
Look at that sky! It ___ rain.

exercises.sentence: Look at those black clouds! It will rain.
exercises.explanation: Прогноз за тим, що бачимо → be going to.

exercises.sentence: If it rains tomorrow, we stays at home.

answer: What are you doing this evening?

exercises.prompt: My plan is to learn Spanish next year.
answer: I'm going to learn Spanish next year.
I am going to learn Spanish next year.
exercises.explanation: Намір, вирішений заздалегідь → be going to + V.

answer: I'll help you with your suitcases.
I will help you with your suitcases.
I'll help you with the suitcases.
I'll help you with your luggage.
I'll help you with the luggage.
